en.html:
護氏"...Chachamaru!!"
Chachamaru"Muramasa versus Muramasa. Dream summit showdown. Started already."
Chachamaru"Hmm, Princess still has a solid advantage, obviously... But she went and stepped on a land mine herself. Maybe an upset is possible...?"
護氏"You... So it was you..."
Chachamaru"Hm?"
護氏"You were Silver Star's keeper!"
Chachamaru"That part is wrong. If you mean apun gave her somewhere to stay, then, well, yes?"
護氏"Why!? Why do you turn against me!"
護氏"What grievance did you have!?"
Chachamaru"None, boss. Apun likes you. Likes Rokuhara also."
護氏"Then what is the meaning of this!"
護氏"Manipulating that monster and seeking my head... Have you forgotten who raised you from being nothing but a criminal who murdered her own parent!"
Chachamaru"For all that assistance, many thanks. No, really. Apun is grateful."
護氏"You say it without shame... But whatever you plot, do you expect it to proceed so smoothly?"
護氏"Doushinbou and Shishiku will not meekly take a position beneath you!"
Chachamaru"Include your son also, at least for politeness. ...Anyway, correct, Dada."
Chachamaru"You dying here gives apun no advantage. More work, actually. Unnecessary work..."
護氏"...What? Then why seek my life!"
Chachamaru"Apun has done nothing, no? Princess did it."
護氏"Princess?"
Chachamaru"Silver Star."

護氏 「……茶々丸!!」
茶々丸 「村正対バーサス村正、夢の頂上決戦。 　もう始まってるよー」
茶々丸 「うーん、やっぱ御姫おひめの優勢は固いか……。 　けど御姫もわざわざ地雷踏んでるからな。 ひょっとすると番狂わせもある……か？」
護氏 「貴様…… 　やはり、貴様が……」
茶々丸 「ん？」
護氏 「貴様が銀星号の飼い主だったのか！」
茶々丸 「そりゃ違うけど。 　身柄を預かってたって意味なら、ま、そー かな？」
護氏 「何故だッ!? 　何故、貴様が予に弓引く！」
護氏 「何の不服があった!?」
茶々丸 「んにゃ別にィ。 　おじじも六波羅もあては好きだよ？」
護氏 「ならば、これは如何なる仕儀か！」
護氏 「あのような怪物を操り、予の首を狙うとは ……。 　親殺しの重罪人に過ぎぬ貴様を引き立てて やったのが誰か、忘れたとは言うまいな！」
茶々丸 「その節はお世話になりまして。 　いやほんと、恩に着てるんだけどね」
護氏 「ぬけぬけと言いおる…… 　だが、貴様が何を企むにしろ、そううまく ゆくか」
護氏 「童心坊にせよ、獅子吼にせよ、容易く貴様 の風下につく者どもではないぞ！」
茶々丸 「あんたの雷蝶ムスコも入れてやれよ。一応。 　……まっ、それはおじじの言う通りだ」
茶々丸 「おじじが今ここで死んでも、あてには何の メリットもないやね。 　つーか面倒な手間が増えるだけなんだよな ……」
護氏 「……何だと？ 　ならば貴様、なぜ予を狙う！」
茶々丸 「あてはなんもしてないっしょ。 　やったのは御姫だよ」
護氏 「姫？」
茶々丸 「銀星号ギンセーゴー」

en.html:
護氏"............Then... what do you intend to do?"
護氏"After all this, do you claim you will not lay a hand on me?"
Chachamaru"............Ah. Yes. Cannot quite leave it at that now, can I?"
Chachamaru"Once it has gone this far, somebody must clear it up properly. Otherwise the whole business goes to waste."
護氏"..."
Chachamaru"Princess really does make work for people."
護氏"...What do you mean? You sound as though you are the one obeying that fiend."
Chachamaru"Ears in perfect working order, Dada."
護氏"Do not jest! You are a Lieutenant General of the Dragon Army, Kubou of Horigoe!"
護氏"Commanding ten thousand riders, why would you follow such a foolish criminal!?"
Chachamaru"...Foolish, eh. Yes. Foolish all right."
Chachamaru"Who takes on the whole world over one attachment? There is a limit to being a maiden, no?"
護氏"...?"
Chachamaru"But that is what won apun over. Give me a fool who does something, not a sage who does nothing."
Chachamaru"And Princess is in a different order of foolishness. Kick Enoshima away by sheer devotion to being a fool—that level. Human history has no precedent."
Chachamaru"How am I supposed to resist that? More importantly, if she keeps going straight ahead like this, apun's wish might come true also."
護氏"Wish...?"
